_comment: Foxfire tips (C2; Yugen's phase 3): the tips of the three tails of `tails/fox_nine` that his phase-2 look hides (the middle one, `tail_1`, and the level-of-detail pair at +-18.75 degrees, `fine_tail_1_d` and `_e`) repainted in their own slot (`main`, his `metal`: white like the other tips in the base texture) and lit in the phase texture's glow mask (`glow: phase`). The phase texture shows from phase 2 on, and those three tails are hidden through phase 2, so their tips burn only when they come back in phase 3 (his phase-3 palette turns the slot foxfire blue): no extra bone or cube.
